record.reason: Variable-size inputs are common in deep learning, but dense batching allocates a shared envelope and spends computation on padding. The cost multiplies across varying axes: an explicit pair state allocates $BN_{\max}^2$ positions instead of $\sum_i N_i^2$. Packing removes that waste, but composing packed operations still requires the logical axes and sample boundaries a flat buffer no longer exposes.
